title: Convert Your Hourly Rate to Annual Pay with Salary Packaging Adelaide Options

bodyMarkdown:
## From Hourly to Annual: Understanding Your Full Pay Picture

If you are paid by the hour or have a salary offer, converting your hourly rate to an annual figure helps you compare jobs and plan your budget. The standard formula is simple: multiply your hourly rate by the hours you work each week, then multiply by 52 weeks. For most full-time roles, we assume a 38-hour week, as set by the Fair Work Ombudsman. This gives your gross annual pay before tax, Medicare, and super.

For example, if your hourly rate is $30.00, your annual gross is $30 × 38 × 52 = $59,280. This calculation assumes you work the same hours every week, with no unpaid overtime, penalty rates, or allowances. It is a starting point for estimating your take-home pay and total employment cost.

### The Fortnightly View

Many Australians are paid fortnightly. To find your fortnightly gross, multiply your weekly pay by 2. Using the same $30/hour example, weekly pay is $30 × 38 = $1,140, so fortnightly is $2,280. This can help you match your budget to your pay cycle.

## Minimum Wage and Award Rates

The National Minimum Wage from 1 July 2026 is $26.44 per hour, or $1,004.90 per week for 38 hours. Casual employees receive a 25% loading, making the casual minimum $33.05 per hour. Award rates for specific industries may be higher. Always check your applicable award or enterprise agreement. The Fair Work Commission sets these rates, and the Fair Work Ombudsman provides [pay guides](/blog) for each award.

If you are a casual worker, remember that the 25% loading is paid on top of your base rate. When using [the timesheet](/), you can check a box to add casual loading. Never type a rate that already includes loading—enter your base hourly rate.

## Superannuation: Paid on Top

Your employer must pay super guarantee contributions of 12% of your ordinary earnings, on top of your salary. This is not deducted from your hourly rate. For the $30/hour example, annual super would be 12% of $59,280 = $7,113.60, but only up to the maximum contribution base of $270,830. Super is an additional benefit that goes into your nominated fund.

## Tax and Medicare in 2026-27

Once you have your annual gross, you can estimate tax using the resident tax rates for 2026-27:
- Nil on income up to $18,200
- 15% on income from $18,201 to $45,000
- 30% on income from $45,001 to $135,000
- 37% on income from $135,001 to $190,000
- 45% on income above $190,000

Medicare levy is generally 2% of taxable income. Low-income earners may get a reduction using the 2025-26 single reduction thresholds (the 2026-27 thresholds were not confirmed at the time of this estimate). For a single person earning $59,280, tax would be approximately $7,717 plus Medicare of $1,185.56, leaving take-home pay around $50,377.44. Use [take-home pay](/topics/take-home) tools for a more detailed estimate.

## Salary Packaging Adelaide: A Local Option

If you live or work in Adelaide, salary packaging can reduce your taxable income by allowing you to pay for certain benefits (like a car or laptop) with pre-tax dollars. This is common in not-for-profit and public sector roles. When converting your hourly rate to annual, consider that salary packaging Adelaide arrangements may lower your taxable income, affecting your tax and Medicare. However, our calculator does not deduct salary packaging—it is an additional step you arrange with your employer. For more details, see [super and packaging](/topics/super-and-packaging).

## Using the Hourly to Annual Timesheet

Our [the timesheet](/) lets you enter your base hourly rate and see annual, fortnightly, and weekly figures. A checkbox adds 25% casual loading if applicable. The results show gross pay, estimated tax, Medicare, and super. Remember that super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax uses the 2026-27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 thresholds were not confirmed. HELP repayments, Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted.

### Average Earnings for Comparison

The Australian Bureau of Statistics reports Average Weekly Earnings for May 2026: full-time adult ordinary time earnings were $2,083.70 per week, and all employees total earnings (including part-time) were $1,579.20 per week. These are averages across all industries and states, not a median for your specific job. Use [average pay](/topics/average-pay) for more context, but remember your individual rate depends on your award, agreement, or market conditions.

## Summary

Converting hourly to annual is straightforward: hourly × hours per week × 52. For full-time, use 38 hours. Consider tax, Medicare, and super to understand your total compensation. If you are in Adelaide, explore salary packaging Adelaide options to potentially reduce your tax. Always check your specific award or agreement for accurate rates. Our [reference tables](/data) provide more figures for different scenarios.

### Disclaimer

Annual pay here is hourly rate × hours per week × 52. It assumes the same rate every week, no unpaid overtime, no penalty rates, no allowances, and no salary sacrifice. Super is estimated at 12% of ordinary earnings only, paid on top, and stops at the $270,830 maximum contribution base. Tax is the 2026-27 resident scale with the full tax-free threshold. Medicare uses the 2025-26 single reduction thresholds because the 2026-27 reduction thresholds were not confirmed here. HELP, the Medicare levy surcharge, and salary packaging are not deducted. This is an estimate, not a determination of your pay or tax.
